plainTranslation: Composite Ascendant in Leo: presents as warm, confident, and a little theatrical - a couple that's noticed. Gift: magnetic and generous. Watch: reading as showy or attention-seeking.
policy: Composite chart entries describe the relationship as a third entity. Read alongside synastry; do not use as a verdict on whether a relationship should continue.
